notes.title: Sea shanties sailing session
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37229443/2764c8bdfcde2491263dfccf810ae4ff76ec9954.gif[/img]

You can just sail around and relax, but if you looking for activities to do:
[list]
[*] Sing sea shanties
[*] Play a "fetch" game with the MarineVerse box. Can you get to the box first? When you do, it teleports to a new random location.
[*] Race around the Orange buoy marker course
[*] Race around the Blue buoy marker course
[*] Find someone who wants to learn how to sail, and explain to them how the sailing works.
[/list]

Make sure to invite your friends! Feel free to share this trailer: 
[previewyoutube=97vReGHi94A;full][/previewyoutube]

Chat with other sailors on [url=https://discord.gg/SxqQs7A]Discord[/url].

Happy sailing!

MarineVerse team

notes.title: Simple relaxing sailing game
notes.content:
Ahoy!

[b]Welcome to Pancake Sailor[/b] - a relaxing sailing game!

[i]In March 2020 sailors around the world found themselves quarantined at home. In response to this emerging situation the MarineVerse team decided to create something that will be accessible to as many people as possible.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37229443/bf3fbbfa9848c2a32b7960835e4d5e4b32280038.jpg[/img]


Pancake Sailor offers a relaxing exploration mode with simple keyboard controls, an Easy Race with a global leaderboard and a multiplayer mode.

The multiplayer is connected to VR Regatta, so if you or your friend has a virtual reality headset, you can sail together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37229443/2f375b8d599ab3381941b74b755e5053c2116358.jpg[/img]

[h1]Manual[/h1]

A basic game manual: 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2039440750

[h1]Bugs & Support[/h1]
We are sorry if something is broken :-( 

Let us know and we will try to fix it asap!

To report a bug, please follow instructions here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1274800/discussions/0/2150972948817461721/

[h1]Community & Multiplayer[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/SxqQs7A]Join our community on Discord[/url]. Meet the dev team. Ask questions. Organise multiplayer sailing.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We will listen to your feedback and suggestions. Please share it with us here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1274800/discussions/0/2150972948813681799/

We are hoping to release a Mac version soon.

[h1]Happy sailing![/h1]

Thank you for trying Pancake Sailor. If you enjoyed the game please make sure to share with your friends & leave a review. Let's share the joy of sailing!

MarineVerse Team
